topic: Shrinkflation -- the same price for quietly less product -- has cost the average household real money without a single price tag changing
title: Shrinkflation Is Costing You Hundreds Without Changing a Price
description:
Companies are charging you the same price for less product, and it's a hidden price hike. We break down the math of how shrinkflation works and what it costs an average family.

#shrinkflation #personalfinance #inflation #moneytips #budgeting
